items.title: Isaiah Morgan Interview, 1958-12-01
items.q: I started taking lessons from old man, old man Delmar, a man from Baton Rouge.

ctx.x: Well, how did you get started in music yourself? Did you pick it up yourself?

I just picked it up my own self. I used to listen at these records. Wind King. I used to hear Wind King. Wind King, I think that's his name. And I wanted to learn music. So I picked that up my own self. I always wanted to blow my brothers home, but he didn't want me to blow it, you see? And blow on it, and after I found I could feel it, well, I just went on. Well, Jim Lill was the first man, stopped me out. We went down to Beuris, Louisiana, playing a carnival dance down there. Well, I couldn't play nothing. He…
I was wondering, what were those first four tunes that you played? Do you remember the first four tunes that you played?
